headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Ben Rice leading the charge at the plate. Rice's impressive performance included a home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Boston Red Sox took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3, with Jake Bennett earning the win.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with the Toronto Blue Jays' Addison Barger being transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 22, 2026, with a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 21, 2026, with left plantar fasciitis.

The Kansas City Royals acquired RHP Max Martin from the Houston Astros in exchange for RHP Nate Pearson. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded for RHP Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies, sending RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek to Colorado in return. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 5-3 Victory Over Yankees**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought 5-3 win over the New York Yankees, with Ben Rice leading the charge at the plate. Rice's impressive performance included a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout victory. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, RBI, and three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Kyle Bradish earning the win. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling 5-6 Loss to Braves**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 5-6 in a closely contested game, with multiple players making significant impacts on the field. Impact hitters for both teams included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith, while Chris Sale stood out among the pitchers.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
